}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== Consists of carrier board for [[CompuLab CL-SOM-iMX7]]
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Freescale (NXP)]] i.MX7D (MCIMX7D5EVM10SD) [[ARM]] :@1.0GHz Dual Core (Cortex-A7)/@200MHz (Cortex-M4) *Storage: 16GB (eMMC), 2MB (SPI NOR) Flash *Memory: 1GB (DDR3L) SDRAM *Wi-Fi: [[Texas Instruments]] WL1837 (2T2R) :SDIO : Wi-Fi 802.11abgn, UART/PCM: BT 5.1 BLE *Network: 2x GbE port via edge connector *USB: 4x USB 2.0 (Host) ports *PCIe: PCIe 2.1 slot w/connected uSIM socket *GPIO: 1x 14-pin headers *Power Source: 12V/3A via barrel or 802.3af PoE
